$comment: EXP-1635 (owner 2026-11-04): SHARING INTO EXPONENTIAL ×3 (iOS `ShareExtension`, Android `ui/share`, web `/share` behind the PWA manifest's `share_target`; the desktop has no share surface). Model = pure `shareTargets` + `shareChatText` + `directShareEntries` + `parseDirectShareId` (src/share-targets.ts; iOS ExpCore `ShareTargets.swift`, Android `domain/ShareTargets.kt`), every mirror replays the `*Cases`. STEP 1, the SHARE TO page (`copy.title`): a preview line (the shared images' thumbnails + `copy.imagesOne`/`copy.imagesMany`, no line for a text-only share), then one Section of plain Rows, `new-issue` (`icons.newIssue`) then `new-chat` (`copy.newChat`, subtitle `copy.newChatSubtitle`, `icons.newChat` = the agent row's dotted circle), then a Section titled `copy.agents` holding one Row per agent in agent-settings.json `orderedAgents` order (the Assistant first, then the team agents the viewer sees; each leads with the chats.json agent bubble; no Section when there are none). Every row has the right chevron. Existing styleguide Rows only: NOT a new component, NOT an Exponential UI primitive. A viewer on more than one team gets the team selector the share flow already has over the rows. STEP 2: `new-issue` = today's share-mode New issue page (board picker on top, Back returns to Share to) ON THE PICKED TEAM (#EXP-1823): `shareIssueBoards` = that team's boards only, the default the last-used board when it is one of them, else the team's first; never another team's board, and the issue's team, labels, statuses and members follow that board. `new-chat` or an agent = THE composer (composer-home.json: the agent row over the card) prefilled with `shareChatText` and with the images/files as its ordinary pending attachments (the composer's own caps + toasts apply, composer-menu.json `add-file`), the agent row seeded on the pick (`new-chat` = Temporary session). NOTHING is sent until the viewer taps Send. iOS draws that composer card inside the share extension and sends through sessions.send, staying in the sharing app; Android and web draw it on the Agent tab. A Temporary session needs a device: the composer's own default, with the + menu's Device row. DIRECT SHARE (the OS-drawn rows of the system share sheet; iOS `INSendMessageIntent` donations, Android sharing shortcuts): `directShareEntries` = the agents in `orderedAgents` order, then the recent chats newest first (no chat that is already an agent's own conversation, and no ENCRYPTED chat, one with a tree key or a sealed title: owner 2026-11-04, its title never reaches the OS, the app-group mirror or a shortcut), capped at `directShare.maxEntries`. Each carries the id `directShare.agentPrefix` + agent id, or `directShare.chatPrefix` + session id. A share arriving on such an id SKIPS step 1: an agent id opens step 2 seeded on that agent, a chat id opens that chat's composer with the same prefill; an id `parseDirectShareId` rejects, or one naming an agent or chat the viewer no longer sees, falls back to step 1. Web has no direct share. TEXT: `shareChatText` = the trimmed text, then the url on its own paragraph unless the text already holds it; with no images the subject (a link's page title, an email subject) LEADS as its own paragraph unless the text already holds it; with images the subject is dropped (it is a filename, like the issue path's prefill). Android also takes selected text from any app (`ACTION_PROCESS_TEXT`), the same flow with `text` only.
